blocks.text: With Lukáš Bech, Antonín Vaňha, Eva Kačírková
Courtesy of Národní filmový archiv, Prague

A tragicomic gallery of characters composes this satirical fresco of a hellish housing estate. In this dysfunctional, endless chaos, people try to get on with their lives amongst the rubble and the mud of this new socialist nightmare. After being blacklisted for years, Věra Chytilová returns to her radical style with a film that still resonates in a society of individuals living in crowded isolation.
Digitisation carried out in UPP and Soundquare by the KVIFF in collaboration with Národní filmový archiv, Prague and the Czech Audiovisual Fund, funded by Milada Kučerová and Eduard Kučera.
